app SequenceAlias
use Provider {take as alias}
Given
When
 scenario echo(value:text) read=true -> text by=members
  do return value
  examples
   do
    let word="A"
    call echo {value=word} by=self
    alias(b="B",a=word) -> "A|B"
Then
package Provider
 Given
  export derive take(a:text="D",b:text=a):text = format("{a}|{b}",{a=a,b=b})
 When
 Then
